subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should external source chats keep automatic bare-text replies by default, or should channel-visible turns require explicit message-tool/final-only delivery?
rationale: Automatic bare-text delivery is shipped and compatibility-sensitive, but it is also the path that lets internal reasoning or inter-tool narration escape to real channels.

options.title: Make explicit delivery the channel default
options.body: Treat bare assistant text as internal for external channels and require message-tool or final-only output, with migration/docs for users who relied on automatic replies.

options.title: Keep automatic default with narrower guards
options.body: Preserve compatibility and keep adding provider/phase-specific leak suppression, accepting a larger ongoing edge-case surface.

options.title: Add an opt-in strict mode first
options.body: Ship strict delivery as an existing-config or documented opt-in mode while maintainers collect upgrade proof before changing defaults.

recommendation.title: Make explicit delivery the channel default
recommendation.body: Treat bare assistant text as internal for external channels and require message-tool or final-only output, with migration/docs for users who relied on automatic replies.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh carried the current source-reply and agent delivery surfaces most directly in recent main history.
